name: Importance Sampling for Specular Term
aliases: Inverse Transform Sampling for GGX-like Distribution
definition: A Monte Carlo integration method for computing the specular term in the NDJIR forward rendering model, using importance sampling based on a specific PDF derived from the D term and geometric factors.
summary: This method computes specular terms in NDJIR rendering by sampling light directions via an analytically invertible GGX-derived PDF, distinct from general importance sampling by targeting the specific specular integrand.
